'''The Black Delve''' was a location in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> situated within the [[Har Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In the [[690s BBY]], the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] played a key role in the conflict known as the [[Battles of the Black Delve]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Delve was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]],<ref name="EGtW" /> and was placed in grid square J-16 by the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" />
